scientific_integrity: Analytical proof for all positive parameters in stated range; independent numerical matrix-exponential checks corroborate 128 finite cases but are not proof of the continuum theorem.
scientific_limitations: Rigorous only for two habitats, equal-duration alternating seasons, identical favorable rate a and adverse rate -b, 0<a<b, and conservative unidirectional switching migration at rate m>0. Deterministic exponential growth is not demographic survival probability. Literature priority not independently established; the 2025 Liu--Wang paper was partially accessible.
title: Exact survival frontier for seasonally reversing one-way dispersal between two sink habitats
